combs[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, 61):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        combs[i][j] = combs[i - 1][j] + (combs[i - 1][j - 1] if j > 0 else 0)

total_value = 0

B_count = 0

    elif ch == 'B':
        B_count += 1
        total_value -= (combs[B_count][R] - combs[B_count - 1][R]) * (combs[R + C][R] - A_count)

print(total_value)
